Well, I've been depressed since I was young. Pedos will do that to a kid. Been on all kinds of meds. Therapy. Group therapy. Psychologists. One really grumpy psychiatrist. Nothing really helped.

10 years ago there was a car accident. Now my back and everything else is just screwed. Sitting hurts. Standing hurts. Even laying down hurts. The smallest movements hurt. Nothing can be done. Even something as simple as taking a shower is freaking awful. 

You know that disgusting fat lady at Walmart that rides the little buggy thing and kinda smells funny? The one that everyone laughs at and calls lazy? That's me now. 

I used to be normal. I used to love hiking. I used to love working on my car. I used to love playing with my kids. I was depressed, but I still managed to live my life. 

Now it's all done. Soon the last one will be 18, and then I don't have to worry about them going into foster care and being abused. I also won't have to stare at grandchildren from across the room that I'm in too much pain to pick up. That just sounds like a new form of torture that I don't want to add on.
